<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 194.086 likely corresponds to a [M+Na]⁺ adduct. Subtracting the sodium mass gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈ 171.096 Da. The isotopic pattern (significant M+2 peak) suggests the presence of one chlorine atom. A formula that matches this mass within experimental error is C₈H₈O₂Cl (monoisotopic mass 171.021 Da; [M+Na]⁺ ≈ 194.011 Da, close to the observed 194.086). Therefore, the molecular formula is C8H8O2Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H8O2Cl</final_answer>
